description: Job ads on SEEK Australia or New Zealand for keywords and a place: title, company, location, salary text (when the advertiser shows one), work type, work arrangement, classification, teaser, listing date and job URL, plus the total match count, from SEEK's public job-search JSON service (the one its website uses). Up to 100 ads per page. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_foundit when you need job ads on foundit.in for keywords and an optional city; jobs_gumtree when you need UK job ads from Gumtree, mostly local hourly and trade. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

where.description: Suburb, city or state, e.g. Sydney, Melbourne VIC, Auckland (default: anywhere)

name: jobs_seek
title: Job ads on SEEK Australia or New Zealand for keywords
